title: Shaoyao Gancao Decoction ameliorates rheumatoid arthritis via inhibition of TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Zhao, Yiying; Gao, Kairui; Zhao, Yige; Feng, Chenran; Liu, Haoling; Shi, Lu; Sun, Wenyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药甘草汤通过TNF-α/NF-κB通路治疗类风湿关节炎，虽含分子对接验证小分子与蛋白结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Shaoyao (root of Paeonia lactiflora Pall.) Gancao (root and rhizome of Glycyrrhiza uralensis Fisch.) Decoction (SGD) originated from Shanghan Lun during the Eastern Han Dynasty. As a classical prescription commonly used in the treatment of Bi syndrome-including diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis (RA), osteoarthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis, SGD has demonstrated notable efficacy in alleviating joint swelling and pain. However, its active components and mechanism of action against RA have not been fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the active components in SGD and to explore its underlying mechanism of action against RA. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rat model and an MH7A cell model were used to investigate the therapeutic effects and underlying molecular mechanism of SGD in vivo and in vitro. Evaluated parameters included hind paw swelling, ankle circumference, arthritis index (AI) score, mechanical withdrawal threshold (MWT), pain pressure threshold (PPT), and ankle joint histopathology. The chemical profile of SGD and synovial tissue was analyzed using UHPLC-QE Plus-MS/MS. The levels of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and COX-2 were measured in rat serum and in MH7A cells following treatment with SGD and its key constituents-paeoniflorin, liquiritin, glycyrrhizic acid, and glycyrrhetinic acid (PLGGS). Protein expression of TNF-alpha, p-IKK, p-IkappaBalpha, NF-kappaB p-p65, and COX-2 was determined using Western blotting. Molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) were performed to verify the binding of PLGGS components to IKK, IkappaBalpha, and NF-kappaB p65 and, thereby, to investigate the modulation of the TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. This integrated approach was used to systematically elucidate the pharmacological effects and potential mechanisms of SGD. RESULTS: Using UHPLC-QE Plus-MS/MS analysis, we characterized 59 distinct chemical constituents in SGD formula granules. Synovial tissue analysis further identified four specific compounds: paeoniflorin, liquiritin, glycyrrhizic acid, and glycyrrhetinic acid. In CIA rats, SGD alleviated hind paw swelling, reduced AI score and local temperature, increased MWT and PPT, decreased thymus and spleen indices, and mitigated ankle joint pathological damage. Both SGD and PLGGS significantly suppressed IL-1beta-induced MH7A cell proliferation, reduced serum and cellular levels of inflammatory factors (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and COX-2), and downregulated the protein expression of TNF-alpha, p-IKK, p-IkappaBalpha, NF-kappaB p-p65 and COX-2. Molecular docking and CETSA results confirmed that PLGGS components exhibit substantial binding affinity to IKK, IkappaBalpha, and NF-kappaB p65. CONCLUSIONS: SGD alleviated RA by inhibiting the TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway, with its efficacy attributed to four active components (paeoniflorin, liquiritin, glycyrrhizic acid, and glycyrrhetinic acid) targeting IKK, IkappaBalpha, and NF-kappaB p65. These findings collectively suggest that SGD is a promising candidate for RA treatment. However, a potential study limitation is the use of a single batch of SGD. Future studies with multiple batches are warranted to confirm the reproducibility of these effects.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：芍药（Paeonia lactiflora Pall. 的根）甘草（Glycyrrhiza uralensis Fisch. 的根和根茎）汤（SGD）源自东汉时期的《伤寒论》。作为常用于治疗痹证（包括类风湿关节炎（RA）、骨关节炎和强直性脊柱炎等疾病）的经典方剂，SGD在缓解关节肿胀和疼痛方面显示出显著疗效。然而，其活性成分及抗RA的作用机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：探讨SGD中的活性成分，并阐明其抗RA的潜在作用机制。材料与方法：采用胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠模型和MH7A细胞模型，在体内和体外研究SGD的治疗效果及潜在分子机制。评估参数包括后爪肿胀、踝围、关节炎指数（AI）评分、机械 withdrawal 阈值（MWT）、压痛阈值（PPT）和踝关节组织病理学。使用UHPLC-QE Plus-MS/MS分析SGD和滑膜组织的化学特征。在SGD及其关键成分——芍药苷、甘草苷、甘草酸和甘草次酸（PLGGS）处理后，测量大鼠血清和MH7A细胞中TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6和COX-2的水平。使用Western blotting测定TNF-alpha、p-IKK、p-IkappaBalpha、NF-kappaB p-p65和COX-2的蛋白表达。进行分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）以验证PLGGS成分与IKK、IkappaBalpha和NF-kappaB p65的结合，从而研究TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB信号通路的调节。这种综合方法用于系统阐明SGD的药理效应和潜在机制。结果：通过UHPLC-QE Plus-MS/MS分析，我们在SGD配方颗粒中鉴定出59种不同的化学成分。滑膜组织分析进一步确定了四种特定化合物：芍药苷、甘草苷、甘草酸和甘草次酸。在CIA大鼠中，SGD减轻了后爪肿胀，降低了AI评分和局部温度，增加了MWT和PPT，降低了胸腺和脾脏指数，并减轻了踝关节病理损伤。SGD和PLGGS均显著抑制了IL-1beta诱导的MH7A细胞增殖，降低了血清和细胞中炎症因子（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6和COX-2）的水平，并下调了TNF-alpha、p-IKK、p-IkappaBalpha、NF-kappaB p-p65和COX-2的蛋白表达。分子对接和CETSA结果证实，PLGGS成分对IKK、IkappaBalpha和NF-kappaB p65具有显著的结合亲和力。结论：SGD通过抑制TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路缓解RA，其疗效归因于四种活性成分（芍药苷、甘草苷、甘草酸和甘草次酸）靶向IKK、IkappaBalpha和NF-kappaB p65。这些发现共同表明，SGD是RA治疗的有前景候选药物。然而，潜在的研究局限性是使用了单一批次的SGD。未来需要多批次研究以确认这些效应的可重复性。
